fields.p_gain: share of entries that ended above the entry
fields.p_flag: tactical: reached +6% (exited there) · speculative: hit the stop · core: fell 10%+ below the entry on the way
fields.hold_mean: tactical: average of simply holding the same entries for the same sessions (what the +6% cap is compared with)

biases: entry at the close, not intraday
note: Base rates of the route rules at any entry day; information only, not used by the method.
